### D1Post

```ts
type D1Post = SqlPostRuntime &
  Readonly<{
    send: (envelope) => readonly D1PreparedStatement[];
    sendFromSelect: (source) => readonly D1PreparedStatement[];
  }>;
```

Post admission statements; callers commit them with the originating D1 fact.

### purgeD1Post()

```ts
function purgeD1Post(source): readonly Readonly<{
  text: string;
  values: readonly (string | number | null)[];
}>[];
```

Remove selected recipient queues, including every envelope and attempt,
atomically. The trusted SELECT yields queue_name from producer/envelope facts,
not job state.
